title: Type definitions (data/defs.json)
description: Object types with their defaults, enemy templates, spells, and the look and rules of the special static block types.

score.description: Points (D100): the score is what the wizard has, worked out from his save bits, never saved itself.

bit.description: Each permanent pickup found (data disk, buff, upgrade, fragment).

enemies.description: Enemy templates (corrupted programs), by id (D79); rooms place enemies of them.

spells.description: Spell tuning, by spell id. What each spell does is built into the engine (SPELL_EFFECTS in src/game.js; Zap: src/entities/bolt.js, Shield and Firewall: Player.raiseShield(), Pause: a bolt that freezes, Enemy.freeze(); Blink and Warp: Game.teleport(), src/entities/warp.js; Cut & Paste: Game.cutOrPaste(), src/entities/clip.js; Pull: src/entities/pull.js, Enemy.pull(); Compile: src/spells.js compile(); Fork: src/entities/decoy.js; Scan: src/entities/scan.js).

zap.description: A fast bolt the way the wizard faces; it stops at blocks and objects and hits the first enemy in its way.

speed.description: Bolt speed in units per second.

damage.description: Integrity an enemy loses per hit.

shield.description: A crackling ring of electricity round the wizard for a while (D73); it blocks enemies' ranged attacks: bolts, arcs and bursts (D84).

duration.description: Seconds the shield stays up; casting it again starts it over.

firewall.description: A ring like the Shield (D84) that also blocks touch attacks and burns every enemy touching it; casting it or the Shield replaces the other.

duration.description: Seconds it stays up; casting it again starts it over.

damage.description: Integrity an enemy touching the ring loses per burn.

burnInterval.description: Seconds before it burns the same enemy again while it stays touching.

pause.description: A bolt the way he aims that freezes the first enemy it hits (D85): it stands still, harmless and solid, a platform, until it thaws; hits still hurt it. Enemies with pausable false shrug it off.

speed.description: Bolt speed in units per second.

duration.description: Seconds an enemy stays frozen; freezing it again starts it over.

blink.description: A short teleport the way he aims, level, through open space only (D86): over holes, hazard and void floors and through enemies, hitting each it passes; a block, an object or the room's side stops it, and he lands short of it, hurt. Right against one, it fizzles and costs nothing.

range.description: Farthest it goes, in units (3 crosses a 2-tile gap, never a 3-tile one).

damage.description: Integrity he loses when a block, an object or the room's side cuts it short (0: never).

hitDamage.description: Integrity each enemy it passes through loses (a spell hit: it provokes and alarms, D81).

warp.description: A teleport the way he aims, level, through open space only, as far as the first block, object or room side (D86); safe. Right against one, it fizzles and costs nothing.

cut_paste.description: Cut the crate or frozen enemy right in front of the wizard into a one-slot clipboard, then paste it into the free cell right in front of him, in this room or another (D87). Nothing to cut or no room to paste: it fizzles and costs nothing.

pasteCost.description: Energy per paste (0: free, so he is never stuck holding something).

compile.description: Compile a temporary crate (D125) into the free cell in front of him at the height of his feet, as Paste puts one (D87): it falls from there, plugs a hole it drops into, can be pushed and pulled like any crate, and derezzes after a while (a plugged hole opens again). No free cell: it fizzles and costs nothing.

duration.description: Seconds the crate lasts; it blinks before it derezzes.

object.description: The object type it compiles: a pushable (a crate).

fork.description: A hologram decoy of the wizard (D129) in the free cell in front of him, at the height of his feet, as Compile puts a crate (D125); it falls from there and stands for a while. It holds a floor plate down, and hostile enemies that see it go for the nearest of it and him, and attack it in vain. One at a time: a new fork replaces the old. No free cell: it fizzles and costs nothing.

duration.description: Seconds the decoy stands; it blinks before it derezzes.

scan.description: A square wave spreads from the wizard's feet over the grid (D128), at every height, out to its range; the fake blocks it reaches derez and the hidden exits it reaches open, until the room resets. It never fizzles.

range.description: How far the wave spreads, in units along x and z (square, like the grid).

pull.description: Pull the first crate or enemy in line the way he aims, at the height of his feet, one cell towards him (D124): a crate as if pushed, an enemy over anything, so it may drop into a hole and pop; pulling an enemy provokes it. A block, the room's side or another body in the way, or a target that can't move (right in front of him, a load on the crate): it fizzles and costs nothing.

range.description: Cells the line reaches, counting the one right in front of him (a target there has nowhere to go).

pickups.description: Pickup types (D71), by id. Permanent ones (data disks, buffs, upgrades, secrets, fragments) set a save bit and stay found; temporary ones (refills, access passes) come back with the room.

blocks.description: Block types (D60), by id; room blocks name one in "type" (default "block"). The engine only knows properties (damage, lethal) and looks; a new type that combines them is data only. Rules the schema can't say (a base type has a look or a kind, not both; which values go with which) are checked by the validator.

block.description: The default type of room blocks; must be static.

slot.description: Index in a block of save bits (D71).

spellSlot.description: Its bit in the save's spell block (D71), also the lit bit on its data disk; unique among spells.

spellColor.description: The spell's color: its disk's lit bit, its effect, its install animation and banner.

spellCost.description: Energy per cast, in whole units (the wizard holds 50); multiples of 10 read best, as the HUD bar has segments of 10.

spellCooldown.description: Seconds before he can cast again.

kind.description: disk: teaches a spell (permanent); refill: restores integrity or energy (temporary); access: a test pass that raises the access level at once, as the core would (temporary, for testing access locks); buff: makes the wizard stronger for good (permanent); upgrade: improves a spell or his jump for good (permanent, D95); secret: a hidden gem worth extra score (permanent, D100); fragment: a key fragment, counted by the core for access levels and the end of the game (permanent, D101).

spell.description: The spell it installs (defs.json spells); its save bit is the spell's slot.

stat.description: What it restores (its look and color follow).

amount.description: How much, up to the wizard's maximum. A refill is left lying while that stat is full.

level.description: The access level it raises the wizard to (D101); it never lowers it, and is left lying while his level is that high already. His level is saved in the key as the core's is.

slot.description: Its bit in the save's buff block (D71), also the lit bit on its chip; unique among buffs.

stat.description: What it raises: maximum integrity, maximum energy, or the recharge rate (its look and color follow).

amount.description: How much: integrity or energy added to the maximum; for recharge, ticks fewer per unit of energy recharged.

upgrade.description: What it does, built into the engine (D95): zap_plus, the Zap bolt bounces off blocks and walls; shield_plus (Shield+), the Shield reflects bolts; double_jump, a second jump in mid-air. One pickup type per upgrade.

slot.description: Its bit in the save's upgrade block (D88), also the lit bit on its card; unique among upgrades.

spell.description: The spell it upgrades (defs.json spells): once found, the spell goes by the upgrade's name in the Tab cycle (ZAP+). None for the jump.

color.description: Its card's contact fingers and lit bit, its install animation and banner; the Shield+ ring too.

bounces.description: zap_plus: how often the bolt bounces off blocks and the room's sides.

slot.description: Its bit in the save's secrets block (D100); unique among secrets.
Its bit in the save's fragments block (D101); unique among fragments.

blockType.description: A base type has a look (a static block in the room grid) or a kind (each cell runs as a room object); a variant ("extends") only the values it changes.

extends.description: Variant: the base block type (one without "extends") whose values it takes; its own values replace the base's.

look.description: Static blocks: plain (dark faces, neon edges), hazard (red pixels switching on and off, flares when it hurts) or void (black mist with gray wisps sinking inside it, D99). Looks are built into the engine (src/render/block-fx.js).

kind.description: Blocks that change: each cell becomes a room object of this kind (src/entities/kinds.js). gate (D140, D141): a block that comes and goes, by its "trigger".

trigger.description: Gate blocks: what makes it go. switch: solid until its switches are all on (the room block entry's "switches", by default every switch in the room), gone while they are; step: a collapsing block (D47), it shakes when the wizard stands on it, then it is gone (back after "regrow" seconds, if given). Either way it comes back only once its cell is clear.

inverted.description: Switch gates only: a bridge, there only while its switches are all on, gone otherwise.

color.description: Edges (and lit pixels or grains). Without a color, plain blocks and gates take the room color (structure, D99); switch gates are white (a mechanism).

damage.description: Static blocks: integrity the wizard loses when he touches it (stands on it or walks into it).

lethal.description: Static blocks: landing on top kills the wizard and enemies instantly; touching a side is safe.

fake.description: Static blocks: solid like any other until a scan reaches it (D128), then it derezzes and stays gone until the room resets. With the plain look and no color it can't be told from a plain block. A pickup may lie inside one (a hidden pickup).

regrow.description: Step gates (collapsing blocks) only: seconds after it goes until it comes back (once its cell is clear). Without it the block stays gone until the room resets.

enemyTemplate.description: An enemy template (D79): rooms place enemies of it. One without "extends" has every required value; one with it only the values it changes.

extends.description: The template it builds on (D58, D79): it takes that one's values (and so on down the chain), its own replace them. No loops.

look.description: Its body (src/render/entity-view.js ENEMY_MODELS). Any look combines with any movement and attack (D78). bug: a hopping ball; virus: a gliding sharp cube with orbiting bits; sentinel: a tall sharp octahedron with one eye; cron: a hex pedestal with a clock dial whose four emitters hold the grid axes (a tower's cross, D83); worm: a head dragging a tail of balls, inching along; crawler: a six-legged spider; warden: a knight of firewall, a kite shield with a helm and a greatsword (D107); daemon: a floating flame, a will-o'-the-wisp; golem: two stacked rack units on slab legs with block fists; wyrm: a flying horned dragon trailing hex plates in shades of its color; phish: a fake data disk that springs on four legs; overclock: a burning CPU chip on its pins; pixie: a butterfly with pixel wings.

movement.description: Movement behavior (src/ai/behaviors.js). patrol: walks its path (room data "path", required) cell by cell, turning back when blocked; stationary: stays in its cell (still falls and rides platforms); chase: goes after the wizard while it sees him within aggroRange (chaseSpeed; needs an aggroRange), searches where it lost him (or where he stood when his Zap hit it) for memory seconds, then goes back to its post, or walks its path if it has one; searching and going back it finds its way round walls. Enemies never step into a hole or onto a lethal block.

attack.description: How it hurts the wizard while hostile. touch: touching it; none: never. burst, arc and bolt are charged attacks (touching it doesn't hurt): when it sees him within attackRange it stops, charges for attackCharge seconds, fires, then waits attackCooldown seconds. burst: lightning all round it, hitting the wizard and other enemies within attackRange; arc: one bolt of lightning, aimed where the wizard stood when it started charging, up to attackRange or the first block or object; it hits every body (the wizard, other enemies) in the squares it passes through; bolt: a slow shot (boltSpeed) at where he is when it fires, stopped by the first body (the wizard, another enemy), block or object it meets.

hostility.description: hostile: attacks (red eyes); peaceful: never attacks (cyan eyes); provoked: peaceful (amber eyes) until a spell, a discharge or a bolt hits it, then hostile.

aggroRange.description: Units within which a hostile enemy notices the wizard, if nothing blocks its line of sight: a chaser goes after him, a charged attack fires; a "!" pops up over it (any enemy). Above 0 for a chaser, at least attackRange for a charged attack.

chaseSpeed.description: Speed in units per second while it chases or searches (chase movement); its speed by default.

memory.description: Seconds a chaser searches where it last saw the wizard (or where he stood when his Zap hit it) before it gives up.

attackRange.description: Charged attack range in units, from its middle to the nearest point of the wizard: a burst's or arc's reach, how near he must be for a bolt.

attackCharge.description: Seconds it charges (the warning) before a charged attack fires.

attackCooldown.description: Seconds after a charged attack before it can charge again.

attackColor.description: Color of a burst's or arc's lightning or of a bolt; its color by default.

boltSpeed.description: Speed of a bolt in units per second (attack bolt); slow enough to dodge.

boltPattern.description: Shots of a bolt attack (D81). aimed: one at the wizard's middle (level if it bounces); cross: four level shots along the grid axes (a tower), fired when it sees him within attackRange like any charged attack.

boltBounces.description: How often a bolt glances off blocks, room sides and objects before they stop it (D81); after its first bounce it can hit its own shooter too. 0: it doesn't bounce.

integrity.description: Hits it takes to destroy (Zap: 1 per hit). At most 15, but a boss ("boss") may take more (D135).

damage.description: Integrity the wizard loses per attack.

speed.description: Walking speed in units per second (along its path too, D119).

bounce.description: Trampoline top: landing on it bounces the wizard up (clearing 2 blocks) without hurting him; its sides still hurt if it is hostile.

solid.description: Solid: the wizard can not walk through it; he stands on it and rides along, and it shoves him when it walks into him (turning back if he is pinned). Touching it counts when he leans against it. Not solid: he walks through it.

pausable.description: Pause freezes it (D85). False: the spell's bolt stops at it and does nothing (for guardians). A boss is never frozen, whatever this says (D134).

color.description: Body (hologram) color; the eyes show hostility.

height.description: Height of its hitbox in units, on a 0.6 × 0.6 footprint in its one cell; its model is drawn as much bigger. Above 1 it stands two cubes high: it needs the cell above it free, and the wizard can't jump over it (D134, D135).

boss.description: Makes it a boss (D104, D134, D135): three gold rings round its body (render/boss-mark.js), a boss bar on the HUD once it is awake (it saw the wizard or was hit), never frozen by Pause nor dragged by Pull. In a room it drops a permanent pickup (room enemy "drop") and stays away once that is found; the room has no shrine, and its doors stay open (he may retreat). It must be hostile.

armor.description: none: every hit counts. plate: spells, discharges and bolts glance off it unless it stands on a floor plate (an object of kind plate, D75), where its armor opens.

phases.description: How it fights as its integrity drops, first to last: each starts once its integrity is at or below its "from" share and changes the template's values it names ("teleport" too). The first has "from" 1; each later one a lower "from".

bossPhase.description: A boss phase (D135): the template's values it changes from when it starts, as the template's fields mean them.

from.description: Share of its integrity at or below which this phase starts (1: from the start).

teleport.description: Seconds between teleports while it is awake: it flickers out and appears in another free cell of its floor, away from the wizard, one that sees him if it can (forcing him to find new cover and retarget). Without it, it doesn't teleport in this phase.

objectType.$comment: A decoration has a look and no color, every other kind a color and no look: checked in src/data/validate.js.

kind.description: Which engine behavior the object uses. pushable: the wizard pushes it; platform: follows its path (room data "path") carrying the wizard and pushables (with "damage" it hurts him instead, a spiked platform, D82); target: a fixed block a Zap switches on and off; plate: a floor tile (y 0) that is on while a crate, an enemy or the wizard stands on it. Targets and plates are switches: they power the room's locked exits, gate blocks and platforms that link them (room data "switches", by default every switch in the room), each powered while all its switches are on (D75, D140); their look is fixed (render/switch-view.js), only the color comes from here. Gates are block types ("blocks", D141). core: the central core (D101), a fixed block that takes the key fragments: touching it raises the wizard's access level to what his fragments earn (world.json "fragments"), and with all of them the Grid reboots; at most one in the world. deco: a decoration (D117), a fixed body as big as its "look" that does nothing; it has no color of its own and takes the room's. Collapsing blocks are block types ("blocks", D60).

look.description: Decorations only (D117): data_pillar: a glass shaft 3 high with data climbing a core inside; screen: a blue glass terminal on a slab, 1 high; memory_stack: glass memory plates on a spine, 1 high, placed side by side and on top of each other as a memory wall (D123). A room object faces +z by default; its "face" override turns it to +x (the two sides the camera sees, D115).

mark.description: Pattern drawn on every face (on a cube-shaped object).

faces.description: dark: like static blocks; tinted: faces shaded in the object color (top lighter, cube only); hazard: the hazard block look, pixels flickering in the object color (D82); glass: see-through faces tinted in the object color, the mark on a small dark core inside (cube only, D96).

shape.description: cube: fills its cell; spiked: a smaller core with four pyramids on each side, their tips reaching the cell's faces (for objects that hurt, D82). Either way it collides as its whole cell.

tint.description: With tinted faces: share of the object color in the top face; the sides get less.

integrity.description: Pushable objects only: makes it destructible, taking this much spell damage (Zap: 1 per hit) before it breaks into pixels. It is drawn with its data bits with some missing (a grid of small squares, holes in it) instead of its mark, so it reads as breakable next to a crate with the whole grid. Without it the object is indestructible.

damage.description: Platforms only: touching it (its sides, its top, riding it) hurts the wizard by this much, like a hazard block (D82). Without it the object is harmless.

timer.description: Targets and plates only: a timed switch (D140), on for this many seconds and then off by itself. A target counts from the bolt that switched it on (another bolt starts the time again), a plate from the moment nothing stands on it. Drawn with a dashed outer square; it blinks while it counts down.
